scope: Real browser Canvas/DOM component interactions against a deterministic AppServices double ONLY

cases.name: real password fields, registration mismatch, rejection and retained input
login submit, keyboard focus and cancel route through services
capability/loading/connecting feedback and audio controls use real app state
native character controls without a fabricated WorldView retain selection on reject
inventory default, right-click, item selection, cancellation and no optimistic grants
drag/swap dispatch, no client mutation, and following click remains live
rejected game action displays actual reason/error ID and retains state
genuine tutorial lock dispatches no actions for mouse or keyboard
bank quantity, notes, search, cancel, rejected amount and atomic state boundary
shop value, buy, sell, zero stock and server rejection
equipment, skills XP, combat/auto-retaliate, run and prayer controls
spell selection, actual renderer world-pick bridge, unavailable target and minimap
dialogue choices/continue, authoritative text and quest journal
resize anchors, no offscreen required controls, reconnect and disposal
